title_zh: FrontierScience：从科学解题到研究子问题评测
title_en: FrontierScience: from science problem solving to research subtasks
summary_zh: 从专家出题、独立复审到 10 分制 rubric，理解竞赛成绩与研究题表现的差异，以及评测分数能说明什么。
summary_en: An illustrated reading of expert task construction, independent review, rubric grading, and the gap between competition scores and research-subtask performance.

paper.title: FrontierScience: Evaluating AI's Ability to Perform Expert-Level Scientific Tasks

title_zh: ScientistOne：用证据链连接论文、代码与实验
title_en: ScientistOne: linking papers, code, and experiments through evidence
summary_zh: 数字来自哪次实验，方法是否对应代码，引用是否真实？沿文献、实验与写作流程，理解证据链和四项产物审计。
summary_en: An illustrated reading of evidence grounding across literature, experiments, and writing, with four artifact integrity checks and their limits.

paper.title: ScientistOne: Towards Human-Level Autonomous Research via Chain-of-Evidence

title_zh: SDE：答对科学题，能否做好科学研究
title_en: SDE: do scientific Q&A scores predict discovery?
summary_zh: 从研究场景、题目测评到多轮项目，理解科学发现能力该怎样评价，以及答题分数何时无法预测研究表现。
summary_en: An illustrated reading of scenario-grounded questions, iterative projects, and the gap between answering science questions and driving discovery.

paper.title: Evaluating Large Language Models in Scientific Discovery

title_zh: ScientistTwo：从研究想法到实验反馈
title_en: ScientistTwo: from research ideas to experimental feedback
summary_zh: 按研究流程读懂自主科研：怎样筛选想法、解释提升，再把评审反馈变成下一步实验。配合原论文方法图与核心实验。
summary_en: An illustrated reading of idea screening, ablation, and review-driven experiments, with the original method figures and core evidence.

paper.title: ScientistTwo: Pioneering the Human Knowledge Frontier with Autonomous AI

title_zh: 从一张 CT 开始，理解 Medical VLM 与 Probe
title_en: Understanding Medical VLMs and probes, one CT slice at a time
summary_zh: 把病灶是否存在、模型如何回答，以及 Probe 读出了什么分开理解，建立医学 VLM 可解释性研究的入门框架。
summary_en: A concrete introduction to lesion labels, native model answers, probe predictions, and what they can—and cannot—establish.

title_zh: DeepRare：罕见病诊断中的工具、证据与可追溯推理
title_en: DeepRare: tools, evidence, and traceable reasoning
summary_zh: 从系统架构、实验与失败案例出发，区分带引用的解释、诊断准确性与真正的临床效用。
summary_en: A reading of the architecture, evaluation, failure modes, and limits of an agentic rare-disease diagnosis system.

paper.title: An agentic system for rare disease diagnosis with traceable reasoning

title_zh: 生成—验证—修复：Coding Agent 的证据闭环
title_en: Generate–Verify–Repair: an evidence loop for coding agents
summary_zh: 从可执行任务包到独立验证、局部修复与干净重放，理解 G–V–R 为什么不只是一次自我反思。
summary_en: From executable task bundles to independent verification, targeted repair, and clean replay.

title_zh: Rubric Construction：让评分规则成为可验证的学习信号
title_en: Rubric construction: from scoring rules to verifiable learning signals
summary_zh: 梳理需求溯源、原子准则、hard gates、过程评价与对抗审计，区分评分一致性和规则本身的有效性。
summary_en: A framework for requirement provenance, atomic criteria, hard gates, process feedback, and adversarial audits.

title_zh: 从静态资料到 Agent 训练数据：指令、动作、环境与奖励
title_en: From static materials to agent training data
summary_zh: 同一份文档或工具记录，怎样逐步增加任务、状态与验证结构，转化为 SFT 和 RL 可用的数据。
summary_en: How task, action, state, and verification structures turn static materials into SFT and RL data.

title_zh: AI 故事生成的领域地图：规划、记忆、交互与评价
title_en: A field guide to AI story generation
summary_zh: 从 Plan-and-Write 到长篇记忆与读者选择，整理生成路线、评价维度和优先阅读清单。
summary_en: A map of long-form planning, narrative memory, interactive choices, and story evaluation.

summary_zh: 不更新模型权重的语言反思，如何影响下一轮行动，以及错误记忆为什么需要被检查。
summary_en: How verbal feedback changes future trials without weight updates, and why reflective memory needs verification.

paper.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning

title_zh: CRITIC：让自我修正依靠工具证据
title_en: CRITIC: grounding self-correction in tool evidence
summary_zh: 将初答、外部工具核验与修订连接起来，理解 self-critique 和 tool-grounded critique 的区别。
summary_en: Connecting initial answers, external validation, and revision with auditable tool evidence.

paper.title: CRITIC: Large Language Models Can Self-Correct with Tool-Interactive Critiquing

title_zh: Self-Refine：自反馈迭代的能力与边界
title_en: Self-Refine: the promise and limits of self-feedback
summary_zh: 同一个模型扮演生成、反馈与修订角色，是一个简单而重要的推理时优化基线。
summary_en: A useful baseline in which one model generates, critiques, and revises its own output.

title_zh: PaperBench：怎样评价一次论文复现
summary_zh: 将长时程复现拆为可评分的层级子任务，理解 rubric、产物证据与自动 judge 的关系。
summary_en: How hierarchical rubrics connect research-replication artifacts to scalable assessment.

paper.title: PaperBench: Evaluating AI’s Ability to Replicate AI Research
